item.title: 'Palestinians are unbelievable people: Vast majority of in Gaza just want to live a normal life'

He offers a stark assessment of conditions in Gaza following the October 2025 ceasefire. item.title: Middle East live: US military says Iran launched seven ballistic missiles at Kuwait, Bahrain
item.description: US military officials on Saturday said Iran launched seven ballistic missiles toward the neighbouring Gulf nations of Kuwait and Bahrain, with US forces intercepting six of the missiles and a seventh failing to reach its target. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they had hit "enemy bases" in the Gulf. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: 'Not your country': Lebanese leaders rebuke Iran as Israel, Hezbollah trade attacks
item.description: Lebanon's president and prime minister criticised Iran on Friday for opposing the latest ceasefire deal between the Lebanese government and Israel, saying their country should not be used by Tehran as a "bargaining chip" in talks with Washington. Despite the truce, Lebanese media reported continued Israeli attacks on the south while Iran-backed Hezbollah said it targeted Israeli troops with drones and rockets.

item.title: Hezbollah chief rejects truce as Israel vows continued operations in south Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah on Thursday rejected the latest ceasefire agreement between Israel and the Lebanese government, demanding a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as more fighting there hampered efforts to end the Iran war. The Hezbollah announcement came as Israeli strikes killed at least eight people, according to Lebanese authorities, and a UN peacekeeper was killed in the crossfire.

item.title: What Visual Evidence Tells Us About Israel’s Use of White Phosphorus in Lebanon
item.description: Videos collected by The Times shows how the Israeli military has deployed a munition that can be extremely harmful over populated areas in Lebanon.

item.title: A 'ceasefire war' in Lebanon continues as 'chaotic global leadership' takes its toll
item.description: Hezbollah's chief on Thursday rejected a conditional truce announced by Lebanese and Israeli envoys, demanding instead a comprehensive ceasefire and full Israeli withdrawal as he threatened northern Israel with new attacks. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.

item.title: U.S. military says it shot down Iranian drones launched toward Gulf allies
item.description: The exchange of strikes comes as the Trump administration ramps up pressure on Iran to make a deal to end the conflict.
